CustomField.description: The exemption authorisation number the purchaser wrote on their 51A126 - the number the Department of Revenue issued them. Unique, so one organisation cannot end up with two certificate records, and an external id so a repeat order updates the certificate it already has instead of creating another.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The exemption number from the buyer's 51A126. One record per number.
CustomField.label: Exemption ID
